title.description: Full name of the chapter or unit.
title.title: Title

short.description: Shorter label for chips; defaults to title.
short.title: Short

description: What the course is, and its list of topics.

code.description: Short code shown on the course card, e.g. `MLPR`.
code.title: Code

series.description: Only when this folder is another year of a course that already has a folder: the name of that first folder, e.g. `mlpr`. Folders sharing a `series` are one course in different years: the dashboard opens the latest, and the course page offers every year at the top.
series.title: Series

semester.description: Which semester of the programme the course belongs to, e.g. `5`. The dashboard groups courses by it.
semester.title: Semester

status.description: `archived` is a finished course: it is left out of Next up and of the landing page, and without a `semester` it folds away at the bottom of the dashboard.
status.title: Status

enabled.description: `false` keeps the course out of sight until the owner switches it on (here, or in the admin). For a course nobody has reached yet.
enabled.title: Enabled

has_educator.description: `true` says someone is writing this course. While it has no content its page then says the content is on its way, instead of asking for an educator.
has_educator.title: Has Educator

hue.description: Colour of the course, 0-359 on the hue wheel.
hue.title: Hue

order.description: Position among courses of the same semester.
order.title: Order

description.description: One or two sentences shown under the title.
description.title: Description

topics.description: Chapters or units, in teaching order. Everything else refers to these.
topics.title: Topics

title: CourseFile
